# GraphBasedSemanticRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing paradigm where data packets traverse a semantic graph, with each hop representing a feature-based similarity transition between concepts. Suggests a new routing logic for TCC interconnects that prioritizes semantic proximity over physical address, enabling content-aware data movement.
